title: CRUD Operations
definition: An acronym standing for Create, Read, Update, and Delete. These are the four basic functions of persistent storage in any database or API.
simpleExplanation: Almost everything you do on the internet is CRUD. Posting a tweet (Create). Scrolling your feed (Read). Editing a typo (Update). Removing a bad photo (Delete). REST APIs perfectly map these four actions to the four main HTTP Methods.
realWorldExample: A Todo List app. Adding a task is Create. Viewing tasks is Read. Checking a task off is Update. Trash can icon is Delete.

basic: Which HTTP method maps to the 'Create' operation in CRUD?
intermediate: Which HTTP method maps to the 'Read' operation?
